rule.description: A named struct type that declares at least 12 methods, splits them into at least 3 disjoint receiver-state clusters (union-find over receiver fields co-accessed across methods), and is re-entered by at least 3 other structs in the same package that hold a field of that type and call its methods through that field.

checks.description: Detect struct types whose method set is large, incohesive, and fed by helper structs, i.e. central god objects.
checks.detected_relation: god object type <- absorbed responsibilities measured as method mass, disjoint receiver-state clusters, and satellite count
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: One type owns method bodies spanning unrelated state clusters instead of delegating to cohesive owners; the satellite count proves that other impl structs lost their implementations to this hub.

matches.evidence: Installer declares 47 methods forming 19 disjoint receiver-state clusters and is re-entered by 8 helper structs; the god-method locations listed as entries are part of the measured method mass.

checks.description: Detect helper structs that hold a field of the god object and call its methods through that field instead of owning the behavior themselves.
checks.detected_relation: helper struct -> god object method invoked through a back-reference field
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each back-reference inverts the intended ownership direction: the helper is the cohesive owner of the responsibility but its public method only forwards into the central god object, which absorbed the implementation body.

matches.evidence: CargoPackageInstallerImpl holds field installer (*Installer) and its Install forwards to the god method runCargoInstall.
DedicatedInstaller holds field installer (*Installer) and its install forwards to the god method installDedicatedTool.
GoBuildInstallerImpl holds field installer (*Installer) and its Install forwards to the god method runGoBuild.
GoInstallInstallerImpl holds field installer (*Installer) and its Install forwards to the god method runGoInstall.
cosignVerifier holds field installer (*Installer) and its Verify forwards to the god method verifyArtifactCosign.
gitHubArtifactAttestationsVerifier holds field installer (*Installer) and its Verify forwards to the god method verifyArtifactGitHubAttestations.
minisignVerifier holds field installer (*Installer) and its Verify forwards to the god method verifyArtifactMinisign.
slsaVerifier holds field installer (*Installer) and its Verify forwards to the god method verifyArtifactSLSA.

excluded.reason: Test doubles implementing the helper interfaces; test infrastructure is outside the production rule, and each is far below the method-mass threshold.

excluded.symbol: DownloadParam, ParamInstallPackage, ParamVerifyChecksum and other parameter structs
excluded.reason: Plain data carriers without methods; declared ineligible by the rule's method-set requirement.

excluded.symbol: pkg/controller.Controller and other cross-package holders of *installpackage.Installer
excluded.reason: The rule is evaluated per package, because Go method declarations and the internal fan-in it models live in the declaring package; controller code wires the installer but does not create intra-package satellite re-entry.

excluded.symbol: pkg/installpackage.Installer methods on the clean tree
excluded.reason: The pinned clean tree has at most one satellite re-entering Installer (DedicatedInstaller), below the rule threshold, so the rule does not fire before the change.
